# Daily Report — 2026-10-21

## Task Completed
Added data source tools for managing sys_data_source records (import sets).

New tools: list_data_sources, get_data_source, create_data_source, update_data_source, delete_data_source, load_data_source.

- `list_data_sources`: Filters by name/format/retrieval_method/active; pagination.
- `get_data_source`: Lookup by sys_id or exact name; 404/empty-result guards.
- `create_data_source`: Required name + import_set_table_name; optional format/source/header_row/separator/active.
- `update_data_source`: PATCH any field; empty-body guard; 404 guard.
- `delete_data_source`: 204/404 guards; name→sys_id resolver.
- `load_data_source`: POST to sys_import_set_run to trigger staging table population.

All tools registered in system_administrator and full packages.
